description: On-device voice dictation for BB's chat composer and `bb voice transcribe`, powered by Hex and macOS 26's built-in Apple Speech (SpeechTranscriber + SpeechAnalyzer) or local GGUF speech models (Parakeet, Whisper, Qwen3-ASR, Cohere Transcribe, Nemotron). Starts a warm embedded `hex service --embedded` daemon when BB loads the plugin, transcodes browser microphone clips (`audio/webm`, `audio/mp4`, `audio/ogg`) to 16 kHz mono PCM WAV via `ffmpeg`, and stops the daemon automatically when BB exits.
